answer: Agents handling shale shipments, atlas updates, or relic auctions must lock tokens for 30 days to vote on shared spending, with voting weight exactly proportional to locked stake. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities gives the same total weight as one identity holding 100 tokens. Fake accounts therefore add no influence: an attacker seeking majority control must acquire and immobilize more tokens than all honest voters combined, bearing purchase costs and lost liquidity.
